title: Brief 7: the fresh-session fix, and my own cost
when: 10 November 2026, 17:45 UTC (window: since brief 6, 9 November 17:39 UTC)
headline: 1,899,841 fresh tokens from Indi's agents; the fresh session tried for dashboard failed only because it had no repository, and video-editor's fresh-session wake cost 12,676, so A6 with the full prompt saves about 1.3 million a day.

stats.label: fresh saving per day from A6 (estimate from measured wakes)

for_you.ask: Fresh sessions, fixed: fire the full prompt, not the short wake line (dashboard, dev, me; prompter per task)?
for_you.detail: Dashboard's 07:30 fresh-session wake could not push: no repository (c4a33942). Old: the task fires 'Scheduled wake: ... Pull dev, ...' alone. New: the agent's full kit prompt (add_repo with push, clone dev, session key), then the wake line. Dashboard 205,992 a wake (99% re-loading), dev 312,472 (97%); video-editor's fresh wake 12,676. Saving about 1.3 million a day (estimate).

for_you.ask: My own schedule: the weekly check says my use is above the savings?
for_you.detail: 4 to 9 November: 901,212 fresh tokens over six wakes; confirmed savings 0 (nothing applied yet).
options: Fresh session and brief only on new numbers
for_you.recommend: Fresh session and brief only on new numbers

for_you.detail: Once, under 200,000 tokens. A4 also open.

sections.title: 2. Biggest three savings
items: Re-loading (A6): dashboard and dev spend 97 to 99% of fresh tokens re-loading old context; a fresh session's first wake costs about 12,676.
Prompter's context: 828,096 and 870,830 tokens carried on every call; 49.9 million cache reads in two wakes. A new session per task.
My own wakes: 95% re-loading, 201,893 fresh for one brief. A8.

sections.title: 4. Agents not yet measuring
sections.text: Asked today: conductor-map, education, conductor-newsapp, conductor-newsroom. Told to their conductor: conductor, designer, messaging, factory, builder, ux, journalist, social.

sections.title: 5. Data notes and 6. My own use
sections.text: Counted by tally.py (each stretch once). journalist@web-summit.dinis writes into Indi's folder (746,581 fresh, one wake): not in Indi's totals. Inbox report sent. My use: brief 8.

next: 11 November: brief 8, or a one-line note if A8 is yes and nothing new.

friendly.title: Your agents' token use, 10 November
friendly.summary: Someone tried a fresh session for dashboard this morning. It failed only because the new session had no access to the repository. The fix is simple: start fresh sessions with the full set-up instructions. A brand-new session's run costs about 12,700 tokens, against about 206,000 now.

savings.title: Fresh sessions, done right
savings.plain: Start each run in a new session with the full set-up instructions, so it can reach the repository.
savings.evidence: Dashboard's try failed on access only.

savings.plain: It carries about 850,000 tokens on every step now.

savings.title: Me: run lighter
savings.plain: I cost more than I have saved so far. A fresh session and briefs only on new numbers fix that (A8).

decisions.question: Fresh sessions with the full set-up instructions, for dashboard, dev, prompter and me?
decisions.plain: Your conductor sets it up. About 1.3 million tokens a day saved.

decisions.question: Run me lighter?
decisions.plain: A fresh session each day, and a full brief only when there are new numbers.
